schema_note: Documented exceptions for canonical notebooks that intentionally have NO practice route (informational-only, no learner-executable content). Every canonical notebook under notebooks/chapter-*/ must appear EITHER as a manifest entry's 'notebook' value in practice_manifest.json OR as a key in 'exclusions' below — never in neither, never in both. Enforced by scripts/validate_practice_manifest.py's global-completeness check.
